Subject: Compact -> Elastic migration options & feature credit treatment

Hi Tara —

Thanks again for walking through usage patterns yesterday. Per our conversation, I wanted to outline options for moving NimbleHealth from the Compact plan to Elastic, and how we would apply existing Compact credits and any onboarding concessions.

Summary of options:
- Option A — Immediate tier upgrade to Elastic (monthly commit): migrate all seats, preserves SLA and enables Advanced features (streaming, per-route tracing).
- Option B — Hybrid: keep a reduced Compact seat pool for legacy workloads + add Elastic capacity for new services (best if you want lower near-term spend).
- Option C — Trial migration: enable Elastic for a pilot team (10 seats) for 30 days, then decide.

Credit & pricing treatment (proposal):
- Remaining Compact prepaid credits are eligible for pro-rated application against first two invoices on Elastic.
- We can offer a one-time migration credit equal to 15% of the first three months' Elastic list spend (applies once the amendment is signed).
- If NimbleHealth prefers a price discount instead of a credit, that would require a 12-month committed minimum and we can discuss tiered discounting.

Attachments: price-sheet-compact-elastic.xlsx (detailed line items), migration-playbook-stub.docx

Next steps: can you confirm which option you prefer (A/B/C) and whether Procurement wants a single amendment (preferred) or a month-to-month add-on? I can set up a 30-min call with Rishi to run the technical migration checklist if helpful.

Best,

Tara / Jasmine —

Quick technical + commercial notes from our side (replying inline to Tara's points):

> 1) If we choose Option B (Hybrid), can we retain Compact-level rate limits for the legacy jobs, or does routing to Elastic always mean Elastic billing for those requests?

- Routing is policy-driven. You can route legacy jobs to Compact hosts where capacity exists; those requests will consume Compact units. If routed to Elastic for scale/burst they will be billed as Elastic. We typically recommend an explicit routing policy to avoid unexpected cross-billing.

> 2) How exactly will the pro-rated Compact credits be calculated (invoice date vs. usage date)?

- We apply pro-rated credits based on the unused prepaid period on the Compact contract at the time of amendment execution (invoice date). Practically: remaining dollar balance is converted and applied to the first two Elastic invoices until exhausted; we will include exact line-item calculations in the amendment.

> 3) The 15% migration credit — is that exchangeable for additional rollout assistance?

- Yes. We can either apply the 15% as a billing credit or convert it into a service credit for up to three engineering days of assisted migration. If you choose the latter we will scope a brief SOW.

Recommendation: Pilot (Option C) + service-credit conversion. Run pilot for 30 days, during which we will:
- Provision Elastic pilot cluster (10 seats)
- Provide one week of remote onboarding support from our migration team
- Produce an export/import checklist and KV cache warm-up guide

I've attached a minimal SOW template for the pilot and a migration checklist. If Procurement needs the credit language in the amendment, we can draft a short clause.

— Rishi
